body_lead: Bengaluru : Karnataka govt plans to leverage the Centreâs Bhashini artificial intelligence (AI) platform to make digital governance and citizen services more accessible to people in their preferred languages, including through voice-based interfaces. Information technology minister Priyank Kharge said the state would explore integrating Bhashini with its more than 700 citizen services under Praja Seva and e-governance initiatives.
